_doc.zh: 各类组织如何跟随骨架。defaults 按组织类型给出默认方法；rules 按部件英文名（正则）覆盖，自上而下取第一条匹配的。method：rigid = 整个部件跟随权重最大的一个关节；field = 按体内距离场逐顶点取权重；attach = 两端（或多处）附着在骨上，沿途只跟随附着骨之间那条关节链上的骨（肌肉、肌腱、韧带）；centreline = 先在神经中心线上取权重，再传给管壁顶点。beta 是过渡带相对宽度，smooth 是沿网格平滑权重的迭代次数，allow 是允许的关节 id（正则）。 attachmentExcludes：Z-Anatomy 附着斑块中落在邻近骨上的错误位置（按肌肉名和骨名的子串匹配），不用作附着。 hingeBlend：在这些关节中心 radius（米）以内，按绕屈伸轴的方位角而不是按距离决定跟随近端还是远端（见 tools/rig/bind.ts 的 HingeBlend）。deny：部件不得附着或跟随的关节 id（正则）。 externalWeights：自带外部蒙皮权重的部件（见 tools/rig/external.ts）。 externalWeights[].openDir：有下标对照文件 skin-source.u32 时改用的开口皮肤包（按下标取权重）；ribFollow：胸壁皮肤随肋骨。 externalWeights[].keepInfluence：不许被每个顶点 4 个影响的上限丢掉的关节（正则）。
_doc.en: How each kind of tissue follows the skeleton. `defaults` gives the method per tissue; `rules` override it by the part's English name (regular expression), first match from the top wins. method: rigid = the whole part follows its single heaviest joint; field = per-vertex weights from the in-body distance field; attach = attached to bone at its ends (or at several sites) and following only the bones on the chain of joints between its attachments (muscles, tendons, ligaments); centreline = weights taken on the nerve's centreline and handed to the tube vertices. `beta` is the relative width of the blend zone, `smooth` the number of smoothing passes of the weights over the mesh, `allow` a regular expression of permitted joint ids. `attachmentExcludes`: Z-Anatomy attachment patches that landed on a neighbouring bone (matched by substrings of the muscle and bone names); they are not used as attachments. `hingeBlend`: within `radius` (metres) of these joints' centres, whether tissue follows the proximal or the distal side is decided by its angular position about the flexion axis instead of by distance (see HingeBlend in tools/rig/bind.ts). `deny`: joint ids (regular expression) a part must neither attach to nor follow. `externalWeights`: parts that come with skin weights from elsewhere (see tools/rig/external.ts). `externalWeights[].openDir`: the opened skin package used instead when the index sidecar skin-source.u32 is present (weights by index); `ribFollow`: chest skin following the ribs. `externalWeights[].keepInfluence`: joints (regular expression) that the limit of 4 influences per vertex must not drop.

why.zh: 肩胛骨贴着胸壁滑动：胸壁和背部深层的肌肉虽然与肩胛骨相邻，但不附着于它，也不随它运动。
why.en: The scapula glides over the chest wall: the muscles of the chest wall and the deep back lie next to it but neither attach to it nor move with it.

why.zh: 胸骨没有自己的关节：它骑在第 1–7 肋上，肋上提时被抬起，脊柱弯曲时随胸廓整体弯曲。
why.en: The sternum has no joint of its own: it rides on ribs 1–7, is lifted when they rise and bends with the rib cage when the spine bends.

why.zh: 肋软骨连接肋与胸骨，只跟随肋。
why.en: Costal cartilages join ribs and sternum and follow the ribs only.

why.zh: 舌骨悬吊在肌肉上，没有关节；这里让它随第 3 颈椎运动。
why.en: The hyoid hangs in muscles and has no joint; here it moves with the third cervical vertebra.

why.zh: 半月板附着于胫骨平台，随胫骨运动。
why.en: The menisci are fixed to the tibial plateau and move with the tibia.

why.zh: 前臂骨间膜张在尺、桡骨之间。
why.en: The interosseous membrane of the forearm spans ulna and radius.

why.zh: 上唇（深层的唇部件拆成上、下两个之后的上半）附着于上颌，随颅骨，不随下颌。按英文名匹配，不依赖部件 id；还没有拆分的身体上这条规则不匹配任何部件。
why.en: The upper lip (the upper half once the deep lip part is split in two) is attached to the maxilla and moves with the skull, not the jaw. Matched by its English name, not by a part id; on a body where the split has not happened the rule matches nothing.

why.zh: 下唇附着于下颌骨，随下颌（颞下颌关节）运动。同样按英文名匹配。
why.en: The lower lip is attached to the mandible and moves with it (the temporomandibular joint). Matched by its English name as well.

why.zh: 头部附属结构随颅骨运动。
why.en: Appendages of the head move with the skull.

why.zh: 止于第五掌骨底；斑块被匹配到了邻近的三角骨。
why.en: Inserts on the base of the fifth metacarpal; the patch was matched to the neighbouring triquetrum.

why.zh: 止于𧿹趾远节趾骨；斑块被匹配到了近节趾骨。
why.en: Inserts on the distal phalanx of the great toe; the patch was matched to the proximal phalanx.

why.zh: 止于肱骨结节间沟；肩胛骨上的斑块不作为附着。
why.en: Inserts on the humerus (intertubercular sulcus); the patch on the scapula is not used as an attachment.

why.zh: 止于拇指近节指骨；头状骨上的斑块不作为止点。
why.en: Inserts on the proximal phalanx of the thumb; the patch on the capitate is not used.

why.zh: 起于蝶骨；斑块被匹配到了上颌骨。
why.en: Arises from the sphenoid; the patch was matched to the maxilla.

why.zh: 起于蝶骨；斑块被匹配到了腭骨。
why.en: Arises from the sphenoid; the patch was matched to the palatine bone.

why.zh: 起于上颌骨；斑块被匹配到了鼻骨。
why.en: Arises from the maxilla; the patch was matched to the nasal bone.

why.zh: 起于鼻骨；斑块被匹配到了额骨。
why.en: Arises from the nasal bone; the patch was matched to the frontal bone.

why.zh: 男性皮肤换成了 MHR 拓扑的单层皮肤，上臂与胸壁之间只隔约 9 mm、两腿相贴，按“最近的骨”无法把这样靠近的两片皮肤分开。这里直接采用 MHR 自带的蒙皮权重：先把 MHR 的关节按下面的规则对应到本骨架的关节，再按原始表面上的最近点把权重传给发布的（简化过的）皮肤顶点。
why.en: The male skin is now a single-walled skin in MHR topology with only about 9 mm between upper arm and chest wall and the thighs touching; nearest-bone weighting cannot separate two sheets that close. MHR's own skin weights are used instead: MHR joints are mapped onto this rig's joints by the rules below, and the weights are handed to the shipped (simplified) skin vertices by closest point on the original surface.

why.zh: MHR 的躯干只有骨盆加 4 个脊柱关节，本骨架每个椎间关节各一个：把每个 MHR 脊柱关节的权重按顶点高度分给它所管高度范围内相邻的两个椎间关节。
why.en: MHR's trunk has the pelvis and four spine joints, this rig one joint per motion segment: the weight on each MHR spine joint goes, by vertex height, to the two neighbouring segment joints within the heights that MHR joint covers.

why.zh: 颈部同理：分给 C7…C1。
why.en: The neck likewise: spread over C7…C1.

why.zh: 前臂扭转辅助骨 1–4：旋前的 1/5…4/5，在尺骨（不转）和桡骨（全转）之间按份额分。
why.en: Forearm twist helpers 1–4 carry 1/5…4/5 of pronation: shared between the ulna (no twist) and the radius (full twist).

why.zh: 腕部扭转骨随桡骨。
why.en: The wrist twist joint goes with the radius.

why.zh: MHR 的足趾只有一个“前掌”关节；本骨架每趾各有跖趾关节：每个顶点给最近的那一趾。趾间关节没有对应，足趾皮肤只随跖趾关节。
why.en: MHR has one "ball" joint for all toes, this rig a metatarsophalangeal joint per toe: every vertex goes to its nearest toe. The interphalangeal joints of the toes have no counterpart; toe skin follows the MTP joint only.

genericWhy.zh: 手指：MHR 的指关节中心与本骨架按骨拟合的中心相差 5–17 mm（拇指腕掌关节最大），握拳时 MHR 权重的皮肤拉伸更大；手指之间有空隙，距离场在这里本来就分得开，所以手指仍用距离场的权重。
genericWhy.en: Fingers: MHR's finger joint centres differ from this rig's bone-fitted centres by 5–17 mm (most at the thumb's carpometacarpal joint) and its weights stretch the skin more in a fist; the fingers are apart, where the distance field separates them well anyway, so the fingers keep the distance-field weights.

why.zh: MHR 没有肋关节，胸部皮肤全部挂在胸椎上，吸气时肋骨上提而皮肤不动。离肋骨 20 mm 以内的皮肤顶点把挂在胸椎上的份额全部转给距离场给出的肋骨权重，到 50 mm 处渐变为不转。
why.en: MHR has no rib joints, so chest skin hangs entirely on the thoracic vertebrae and stays put while the ribs rise in inspiration. Skin vertices within 20 mm of a rib hand all of their thoracic share to the rib weights of the distance field, fading to none at 50 mm.

why.zh: MHR 的“锁骨”关节（l_clavicle / r_clavicle）带着整个肩带绕胸锁关节转，本骨架把肩带分成胸锁关节（锁骨）和肩锁关节（肩胛骨，上回旋在这里）。原来这一份全给了胸锁关节，肩胛骨上和肩部的皮肤就不随肩胛骨上回旋：外展 90° 时三角肌、肩锁关节囊、腋神经的皮支和胸大肌从肩部和腋前的皮肤里穿出（男性每侧约 1200 个深部顶点在皮肤外）。这里把它按体内距离场在锁骨和肩胛骨之间重新分：靠近锁骨的随胸锁关节，盖在肩胛骨上的随肩锁关节。胸前的皮肤盖在锁骨、胸骨和胸大肌上（肩胛骨只有喙突在深处），所以在盂肱关节中心之前 0–6 cm 渐渐不分：全分时外展 160° 胸前皮肤随肩胛骨转，腋前襞折起约 6–10 cm²。
why.en: MHR's "clavicle" joint (l_clavicle / r_clavicle) turns the whole girdle about the sternoclavicular joint; this rig splits the girdle into the sternoclavicular joint (clavicle) and the acromioclavicular joint (scapula, where the upward rotation is). All of that share used to go to the sternoclavicular joint, so the skin over the scapula and the shoulder did not follow the scapula's upward rotation: at 90° of abduction deltoid, the capsule of the acromioclavicular joint, the cutaneous branch of the axillary nerve and pectoralis major came through the skin of the shoulder and the front of the axilla (in the male about 1200 deep-part vertices per side outside the skin). Here it is split again between clavicle and scapula by the in-body distance field: skin near the clavicle follows the sternoclavicular joint, skin over the scapula the acromioclavicular joint. The skin of the front of the chest lies over clavicle, sternum and pectoralis major (of the scapula only the coracoid lies deep there), so the split fades out between 0 and 6 cm in front of the glenohumeral centre: split everywhere, the front of the chest turned with the scapula at 160° of abduction and the anterior fold folded over by about 6–10 cm².

keepInfluenceWhy.zh: 她的皮肤包在下颌角一带每个顶点有 5–6 个关节（颅骨、C4、C5、T2、T3 和颞下颌关节），颞下颌关节的份额只有约 0.1，常排在第 5 位而被 4 个影响的上限丢掉，于是相邻顶点的下颌份额在 0 和 0.15 之间跳动，张口到上限时左下颌角处的小三角形翻转，口腔袋从张开的口里露出来（从右前 45° 看 48 个像素）。这里让颞下颌关节不被丢掉，被挤出的是最小的颈部份额，并到骨架上相邻的颈椎关节。
keepInfluenceWhy.en: Round the angle of the mandible her skin package gives each vertex 5–6 joints (skull, C4, C5, T2, T3 and the temporomandibular joint); the temporomandibular share is only about 0.1, often comes fifth and was dropped by the limit of 4 influences, so the jaw share jumped between 0 and 0.15 from one vertex to the next, small triangles at the left angle turned over with the jaw fully open, and the oral pouch showed through the open mouth (48 pixels seen from 45° to the front right). Here the temporomandibular joint is not dropped; what goes is the smallest neck share, merged into the neighbouring cervical joint on the skeleton.

why.en: The female has a skin in MHR topology as well; same procedure as for the male.
